chunks: Al-Hakim Abd al-Hamid ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hasan al-Naisaburi told us, saying: Abu Yazid al-Harawi told us, saying: Salama ibn Shabeeb told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Muneeb al-Adni told us, saying: Al-Sari ibn Yahya told us, from Hisham, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said:

Learn the Master of Forgiveness-seeking: 'O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me, and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and promise as much as I can, and I acknowledge to You Your grace upon me, and I acknowledge to You my sin, so forgive me. Indeed, none forgives sins except You.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Master of Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Mani al-Akhbar*, this hadith highlights the 'Sayyid al-Istighfar' as a comprehensive supplication that integrates theological affirmation with practical repentance. It serves as a model for Shia devotional practice, emphasizing the balance between recognizing God’s divine attributes and acknowledging human servitude and sinfulness. The structure reflects the Shia emphasis on *tawhid* (monotheism) and *ma'ad* (return to God) through daily ritualized remembrance.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by al-Hakim, Abdul-Hameed bin Abdul-Rahman bin Hasan al-Naisabouri, that he said: We were told by Abu Yazid al-Harawi, that he said: We were told by Salama bin Shabeeb, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Muneeb al-Adni, that he said: We were told by Surri bin Yahya, from Hisham, from Abu’l-Zubair, from Jabir bin Abdullah, that the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Learn the Master of Forgiveness-seeking: «O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me, and I am Your servant, and I am on Your covenant, and I acknowledge Your grace upon me, and I acknowledge to You my sin, so forgive me. Indeed, none forgives sins except for You.»
